CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov

Tony Chou, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Hunter Chang, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber
John Chou, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive

Calvin Lo, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 21, 2025 AT 7:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City will
do its best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

  Written public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until
  3:00 p.m. the day of the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will

   be distributed to City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00
  p.m. will be included in the public comment record but not provided to City Council at
  the meeting.
  Written public comment will also be accepted electronically via the zoom.us
  teleconference module during the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted
  after the in-person comments.
  Once the Mayor calls for Zoom comments, they will be read in the order received. No
  further Zoom comments will be read after the conclusion of public comment for that
  item.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chang, Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Vice Mayor Chou, and
Mayor Shepherd Romey

POSTING OF AGENDA

The special meeting agenda is posted 24 hours prior to each special meeting at the following
locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington
Drive, and the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The special meeting agenda is
also posted on the City’s website: www.SanMarinoCA.gov

  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  ADOPT A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN
  MARINO 1) DETERMINING THAT THE AWARD OF A SOLID WASTE AND
  RECYCLING AGREEMENT IS EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA
  ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA), 2) AWARDING AN
  AGREEMENT TO VALLEY VISTA SERVICES, INC. FOR THE COLLECTION,
  TRANSPORTATION, PROCESSING AND DIVERSION OF MUNICIPAL
  SOLID WASTE, RECYCLABLE MATERIALS, FOOD SCRAPS, YARD
  TRIMMINGS, CONSTRUCTION AND DEMOLITION DEBRIS AND OTHER
  MATERIALS AND FOR THE COLLECTION, TRANSPORTATION AND
  DISPOSAL OF MUNICIPAL SOLID WASTE FOR A TEN (10) YEAR PERIOD
  BEGINNING MAY 31, 2025, AND TERMINATING JUNE 30, 2035; 3)
  AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO SIGN THE SOLID WASTE AND
  RECYCLING AGREEMENT ON BEHALF OF THE CITY, AND 4) DIRECTING
  STAFF TO SET A PUBLIC HEARING TO ADOPT THE PROPOSED RATES IN
  ACCORDANCE WITH PROPOSITION 218

AGENDA – MAY 21, 2025  PAGE 2 of 4
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council adopt a Resolution 1)
  determining that the award of a Solid Waste and Recycling Agreement is exempt from
  the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), 2) awarding an Agreement to Valley
  Vista Services, Inc. for the Collection, Transportation, Processing and Diversion of
  Municipal Solid Waste, Recyclable Materials, Food Scraps, Yard Trimmings,
  Construction and Demolition Debris and Other Materials and for the Collection,
  Transportation, Processing and Disposal of Municipal Solid Waste for a ten (10) year
  period beginning May 31, 2025, and terminating June 30, 2035, 3) authorizing the
  Mayor to sign the Solid Waste and Recycling Agreement on behalf of the City, and 4)
  directing staff to set a Public Hearing to adopt proposed rates in accordance with
  Proposition 218. If the Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate
  motion would be:

  “I move to adopt a Resolution of the City Council of the City of San Marino 1)
  determining the award of a Solid Waste and Recycling Agreement exempt from review
  under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Sections 15301,
  15302, and 15061(b)(3) of Title 14, Chapter 3 of the California Code of Regulations,
  2) awarding the Agreement to Valley Vista Services, Inc. for the Collection,
  Transportation, Processing and Diversion of Municipal Solid Waste, Recyclable
  Materials, Food Scraps, Yard Trimmings, Construction and Demolition Debris and Other
  Materials and for the Collection, Transportation, Processing and Disposal of Municipal
  Solid Waste for a ten (10) year period beginning May 31, 2025, and terminating June
  30, 2035, 3) authorizing the Mayor to sign the Solid Waste and Recycling Agreement
  on behalf of the City, and 4) directing staff to set a Public Hearing to adopt proposed
  rates in accordance with Proposition 218.”

2.  1) DETERMINE THE AWARD OF A STREET SWEEPING CONTRACT IS
  EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT
  (CEQA), 2) APPROVE AN AGREEMENT WITH NATIONWIDE
  ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES FOR CITYWIDE STREET SWEEPING
  SERVICES FOR A FOUR (4) YEAR TERM BEGINNING JUNE 1, 2025 AND
  ENDING JUNE 30, 2029 IN THE AMOUNT OF $570,390 ANNUALLY,
  WITH AN ANTICIPATED DISCOUNTED ANNUAL COST OF $508,530
  CONTINGENT UPON THE AWARD OF THE CITY’S WASTE HAULING
  AGREEMENT TO VALLEY VISTA SERVICES, INC., AND 3) AUTHORIZE
  THE MAYOR TO EXECUTE THE AGREEMENT ON BEHALF OF THE CITY

  Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council 1) determine the award of
  a street sweeping contract is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), 2) approve an agreement with Nationwide Environmental Services for
  Citywide Street Sweeping Services for a four (4) year term beginning June 1, 2025
  and ending June 30, 2029 in the amount of $570,390 with an anticipated discounted
  cost of $508,530 contingent upon the award of the City’s waste hauling agreement to
  Valley Vista Services, Inc., and 3) authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on
  behalf of the City. If the Council concurs, an appropriate motion would be.

  “I move to 1) determine the award of a street sweeping contract is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), 2) approve an agreement with
  Nationwide Environmental Services for Citywide Street Sweeping Services for a four
  (4) year term beginning June 1, 2025 and ending June 30, 2029 in the amount of
  $570,390 with an anticipated discounted cost of $508,530 contingent upon the award

AGENDA – MAY 21, 2025  PAGE 3 of 4
   of the City’s waste hauling agreement to Valley Vista Services, Inc., and 3) authorize
  the Mayor to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received
by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to
at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available
at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California
91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at
the City Council meeting.

ADJOURNMENT

Posted: 5/20/2025  ALISON WALKER
  CITY CLERK
